notes.title: Castle of Shikigami 2 - v1.1.0 update
notes.notes:
Dear Users,

We would like to thank everyone's support towards "Castle of Shikigami 2."

We hope you are enjoying it so far. We have just released the latest version 1.1.0, which includes bug fixes reported by the players!

A few problems did stand out, and have now been fixed:

 Fixed some control issues on certain arcade controllers.
 Reviewed the lighting and adjusted some effects.
*Demo version has been updated as well.

Due to the porting process, it is difficult to reproduce the original arcade version completely. With that said, we have adjusted the balance to the very limit of what we can offer at this time. we would appreciate your understanding.

Cheers,

Degica Games team

notes.title: Castle of Shikigami 2 - Community Items update
notes.notes:
Happy New Year! 🎍

We hope everyone had enjoyed the "Castle of Shikigami 2" during the holidays.

We've promised to release the community items, and it's finally here now!


Badge Level 1 - 5 & Special Foil Badge.
13 Trading Card for each individual character.
7 distinct Profile Background.
7 different Emoticon.


We hope you will like the designs (especially the Foil Badge!)

Cheers,

Degica Games team

notes.title: Castle of Shikigami 2 - Demo v1.0.15 update
notes.notes:
Dear Users,

We want to thank everyone's support towards "Castle of Shikigami 2."

We have implemented all the previous fixes into the demo version, so it should now be the best version to ask your friends to give "Castle of Shikigami 2" a try!

Tips from the developer
Here's a small tip for everyone having trouble progressing to the later stages. The credits will increase as your playtime builds up, and eventually, you will be able to play the game without caring about the credits. Let's pick up the controller and give it another shot!

Cheers,

Degica Games team

notes.title: Castle of Shikigami 2 - Demo update
notes.notes:
Dear Users,

Thank you for you positive reception of Castle of Shikigami 2.

First a word of reassurance, this demo is still based on the BETA version, and various features will be improved in the final release.

A few problems did stand out, and have now been fixed:

 Frame rate is not locked to 30fps by default anymore
 Some of the most glaring controller bugs
 Niigi's barrier effects


We're happy to hear any feedback you have.

Cheers

Degica Games team
